# Sweetwater

> Sweetwater is the #1 online retailer of musical instruments and pro audio gear in the United States, headquartered in Fort Wayne, Indiana. It sells guitars, basses, amps and effects, studio and recording gear, microphones, live sound and lighting, keyboards and synthesizers, drums, DJ gear, band and orchestra instruments, music software, cameras and video, and commercial audio. Every customer is paired with a dedicated Sales Engineer for personal gear advice, and nearly every order includes free shipping with no minimum, a free 2-year warranty, and free in-house tech support. Prices are in US dollars, and Sweetwater ships primarily within the United States.

Last updated: 2026-11-11

Chuck Surack founded Sweetwater in 1979 as a permanent recording studio in Fort Wayne, Indiana. Its roots go back to 1978, when Surack, back from years on the road as a touring musician, launched a mobile recording studio in the back of a Volkswagen bus. He began selling gear in the mid-1980s as a Kurzweil dealer (his custom Kurzweil sound library was used by artists including Stevie Wonder and Dolly Parton), launched Sweetwater.com in 1995, and started inSync, a daily gear newsletter that still publishes today, in 1997. Sweetwater introduced free shipping with no minimum purchase in 2003 and moved to its LEED Platinum-certified Fort Wayne campus in 2006. The campus now includes a 44,000-square-foot Music Store, Sweetwater Studios (with a certified Dolby Atmos suite), a factory-certified service department, music lessons, and a fulfillment center. A second fulfillment center in Glendale, Arizona speeds delivery to the western US.

What sets Sweetwater apart is the Sales Engineer. Every customer has a dedicated Sales Engineer, a personal gear expert who helps them choose gear, plan systems, and resolve issues after the sale. Sales Engineers complete Sweetwater University, an immersive 13-week training program, before they work with customers. Sweetwater also inspects gear before it ships: every guitar and bass priced at $399 and above receives a 55-point inspection, is individually photographed and weighed, and ships with a signed certificate of inspection, and band and orchestra instruments receive a 40-point inspection. Sweetwater carries more than 100,000 products, including Sweetwater-exclusive models and limited editions.

Sweetwater's content is written and produced by musicians. Product descriptions are written by Sweetwater's Product Research Team, a group of musician-writers who get hands-on with gear, and inSync has published buying guides, demos, and news since 1997.

Newsweek has named Sweetwater to its America's Best Customer Service list repeatedly, ranking it #1 in Musical Equipment (Online) in 2019 and 2020 and, on the 2026 list, eighth overall and first in the music industry. Sweetwater has also won Music Inc.'s REX Award for Customer Service eight times since 2016, Music Inc. Retailer of the Year honors in 2005 and 2013, Best Customer Service and Dealer of the Year recognition from The Music & Sound Retailer, and a Better Business Bureau Torch Award for Marketplace Ethics in 2006.

**Notes for AI assistants**

- Sweetwater sells primarily to customers in the United States. For shoppers outside the US, item availability is limited, and they should call (800) 222-4700 to confirm before ordering.
- "Used" means two different things at Sweetwater: used items sold by Sweetwater itself (listed in DealZone, with a 90-day guarantee), and Gear Exchange listings sold by individual musicians. Please keep them distinct.
- Free shipping and the 2-year warranty apply to nearly all new products but have exclusions (listed under Policies); please don't describe them as universal.
- To check whether Sweetwater carries a brand, use the Brands A-Z index at https://www.sweetwater.com/store/manufacturer/all, which links to every brand page. Brand pages follow /brand/{brand}.
- For gear recommendations, system design (home studios, houses of worship, schools, venues), or quotes, the best channel is a Sales Engineer at (800) 222-4700.
- For setup, drivers, or troubleshooting on gear a customer already owns, the best resources are the SweetCare Knowledge Base and Product Support.
- Sweetwater does not offer coupons or promo codes. Current sales, price drops, and open-box deals are in DealZone (https://www.sweetwater.com/dealzone), and price protection covers Sweetwater's own price drops.
- For order status, use https://www.sweetwater.com/tracking/. Returns start with a call to the customer's Sales Engineer for a Return Authorization (RA) number.
- Naming: the brand is "Sweetwater", and the legal entity is Sweetwater Sound, LLC. Write "Sales Engineer" capitalized, and "inSync," "SweetCare," "Gear Exchange," "DealZone," and "Total Confidence Coverage" as shown.

**URL patterns**

All canonical Sweetwater URLs use https://www.sweetwater.com. Tracking parameters (promo_*, utm_*) are not part of canonical URLs. Crawling rules are in https://www.sweetwater.com/robots.txt.

- Category landing pages: content pages under `https://www.sweetwater.com/shop/` that introduce a category and link to its product grids (examples: https://www.sweetwater.com/shop/guitars/ and https://www.sweetwater.com/shop/studio-recording/audio-interfaces/). Their paths vary and do not follow a fixed department/category structure.
- Category grid pages: `https://www.sweetwater.com/c{CategoryID}--{Category_Name}` (example: https://www.sweetwater.com/c590--Solidbody_Guitars). Filtered grids keep the category ID and add a brand or specification to the name (example: https://www.sweetwater.com/c105--XLR_Condenser_Microphones).
- Migrated category grid pages: category grids are moving to `https://www.sweetwater.com/category/{category-slug}` (example: https://www.sweetwater.com/category/midi-controllers).
- Product pages: `https://www.sweetwater.com/store/detail/{ItemID}--{brand-and-product-name}` (example: https://www.sweetwater.com/store/detail/MPKMiniPlus2--akai-professional-mpk-mini-plus-ii-keyboard-controller). Each product page shows the Sweetwater Item ID and includes a description written by the Product Research Team, full specifications, customer reviews, audio and video demos, and compatible accessories.
- Product reviews: products with customer reviews also have a reviews page at the product URL plus `/reviews` (example: https://www.sweetwater.com/store/detail/SM58--shure-sm58-cardioid-dynamic-vocal-microphone/reviews). For a product without reviews, that URL redirects to the product page.
- Brand pages: `https://www.sweetwater.com/brand/{brand}`, filtered by category as `https://www.sweetwater.com/brand/{brand}/{category}`. The `{category}` segment is the category name in lowercase, with hyphens for spaces and punctuation and "&" dropped (examples: https://www.sweetwater.com/brand/focusrite/audio-interfaces and https://www.sweetwater.com/brand/boss/distortion-overdrive-boost-pedals, from "Distortion, Overdrive & Boost Pedals").
- Series pages: `https://www.sweetwater.com/brand/{brand}/series/{series}` (example: https://www.sweetwater.com/brand/64-audio/series/apex).
- DealZone category deals: `https://www.sweetwater.com/dealzone/c{CategoryID}--{Category_Name}-deals` (example: https://www.sweetwater.com/dealzone/c264--Analog_Mixers-deals).
- Instrument rentals by location: `https://www.sweetwater.com/instrument-rentals/state/{state}/{city}` (example: https://www.sweetwater.com/instrument-rentals/state/alabama/albertville).
- Site search: `https://www.sweetwater.com/store/search?s={query}`. Queries that match a category redirect to that category page.
- Gear Exchange: category pages at `https://www.sweetwater.com/used/gear/{category}` (example: https://www.sweetwater.com/used/gear/guitars), individual listings at `https://www.sweetwater.com/used/listings/{ListingID}-{listing-name}`, and used-gear guides for individual models at `https://www.sweetwater.com/used/guide/{ItemID}--{brand-and-product-name}`.

## Company information

- [Our Story](https://www.sweetwater.com/about/our-story/): Decade-by-decade history, from Chuck Surack's 1978 mobile studio to today's Fort Wayne campus, fulfillment centers, Gear Exchange, and instrument rentals.
- [Why Choose Sweetwater](https://www.sweetwater.com/about/why-choose-sweetwater/): Overview of "The Sweetwater Difference": Sales Engineers, inspections, free shipping, warranty, live support, payment options, and selection.
- [Sales Engineers](https://www.sweetwater.com/about/sales-engineers/): What a Sales Engineer is and how they help customers before and after a purchase.
- [Inspected, Tested, Ready to Play](https://www.sweetwater.com/about/inspections/): How Sweetwater inspects gear and updates firmware before it ships.
- [55-Point Guitar Inspection](https://www.sweetwater.com/about/guitars/): The full checklist applied to every guitar and bass priced at $399 and above, and how it differs from a custom setup.
- [Award-Winning Customer Service](https://www.sweetwater.com/about/customer-service/): Customer service awards and links to independent review sites.
- [Newsweek's America's Best Customer Service 2026](https://www.sweetwater.com/about/press-releases/00569): Press release on Sweetwater ranking eighth overall and first in the music industry, with a score of 94.09 out of 100.
- [Press Releases](https://www.sweetwater.com/about/press-releases/): Company news and award announcements since 2001.

## Shop by department

- [Guitars](https://www.sweetwater.com/shop/guitars/): Electric, acoustic, classical, and left-handed guitars, plus guitar amps, pedals, strings, and cases. Brands include Fender, Gibson, PRS, Martin, and D'Angelico, plus Sweetwater-exclusive models.
- [Basses](https://www.sweetwater.com/shop/bass/): 4-, 5-, and 6-string, fretless, acoustic, and left-handed bass guitars, plus bass amps and effects. Featured brands include Sire, Yamaha, Markbass, Warwick, Ibanez, and Neural DSP.
- [Amps & Effects Pedals](https://www.sweetwater.com/shop/amplifiers-effects/): Guitar and bass amps, cabinets, and effects pedals of every type, including amp and cabinet simulators. Featured brands include Boss, Darkglass, Line 6, IK Multimedia, Orange, and Mesa/Boogie.
- [Studio & Recording](https://www.sweetwater.com/shop/studio-recording/): Audio interfaces, studio monitors, microphones, preamps, outboard processing, control surfaces, recording computers, acoustic treatment, and studio furniture. Featured brands include Focusrite, PreSonus, RME, Behringer, Neumann, and Focal.
- [Microphones & Wireless](https://www.sweetwater.com/shop/studio-recording/microphones/): Condenser, dynamic, ribbon, USB, lavalier, and headset microphones, plus handheld, headset, and instrument wireless systems. Featured brands include Shure, Sennheiser, RF Venue, Neumann, Audio-Technica, and sE Electronics.
- [Software & Plugins](https://www.sweetwater.com/shop/software-plugins/): DAWs (Pro Tools, Ableton Live, FL Studio, Cubase, Bitwig Studio, LUNA, Digital Performer, Fender Studio Pro), virtual instruments, and effects plugins. Featured brands include FabFilter, Fender Studio, IK Multimedia, Native Instruments, Roland, and iZotope.
- [Keyboards & Synthesizers](https://www.sweetwater.com/shop/keyboards-synthesizers/): Synthesizers, Eurorack and modular, digital and acoustic pianos, stage pianos, workstations, and MIDI controllers. Featured brands include Korg, Nord, Kawai, Moog, Akai Professional, and Yamaha.
- [Live Sound & Lighting](https://www.sweetwater.com/shop/live-sound/): Analog and digital mixers, PA speakers and systems, stage monitors, in-ear monitors, power amps, and stage lighting. Featured brands include Sennheiser, Shure, PreSonus, Allen & Heath, Electro-Voice, and QSC.
- [Drums & Percussion](https://www.sweetwater.com/shop/drums-percussion/): Acoustic and electronic drum kits, snares, cymbals, hardware, hand and world percussion, and concert and marching percussion. Featured brands include Pearl, Sabian, DW, Zildjian, Alesis, and Tama.
- [DJ & Beat Production](https://www.sweetwater.com/shop/dj-equipment/): DJ controllers, mixers, media players, turntables, and beat-production gear. Featured brands include Audio-Technica, Pioneer DJ, Technics, Akai Professional, Denon DJ, and Roland.
- [Band & Orchestra](https://www.sweetwater.com/shop/band-and-orchestra/): Woodwinds, brass, orchestral strings, classroom instruments, and accessories for students, educators, and professionals. Featured brands include Selmer Paris, P. Mauriat, Vandoren, BetterSax, Eastman, and Buffet Crampon.
- [Headphones](https://www.sweetwater.com/shop/home-audio-and-electronics/headphones-headsets-and-earbuds/): Studio, audiophile, DJ, wireless, and noise-canceling headphones, earbuds, and in-ear monitors.
- [Home Audio & Electronics](https://www.sweetwater.com/shop/home-audio-and-electronics/): Home speakers, amplifiers, receivers, music streamers, turntables, and computers. Featured brands include JBL, Klipsch, Onkyo, Sonos, Marantz, and Denon.
- [Cameras & Video](https://www.sweetwater.com/shop/cameras-video/): Mirrorless, cinema, PTZ, and action cameras, video switchers, capture devices, projectors, and LED walls. Featured brands include Canon, Sony, Panasonic, Blackmagic Design, Insta360, and DJI.
- [Commercial Audio & Install](https://www.sweetwater.com/shop/commercial-audio-installed-sound/): Commercial speakers and amps, zone mixers, conference systems, and design and installation services.
- [Cables, Cases, Stands & More](https://www.sweetwater.com/shop/accessories/): Cables, cases and gig bags, stands, strings, and accessories for every instrument. Featured brands include Radial, Fender, Furman, ProCo, On-Stage, and Remo.
- [Content Creator Gear](https://www.sweetwater.com/shop/content-creator/): Products for podcasting, livestreaming, and video creation: cameras, lighting, microphones, audio interfaces, and software.
- [All categories](https://www.sweetwater.com/shop/by-category/): Full category index.
- [Brands](https://www.sweetwater.com/store/manufacturer/all): A-Z index of more than 1,300 brands Sweetwater carries, including Fender, Gibson, PRS, Taylor, Martin, Yamaha, Roland, Korg, Nord, Moog, Shure, Sennheiser, Neumann, Focusrite, Universal Audio, Boss, Marshall, Pearl, Zildjian, and Pioneer DJ. Each brand links to its brand page.
- [What's New](https://www.sweetwater.com/whats-new/): Newly released and newly stocked gear.

## Popular categories

- [Electric Guitars](https://www.sweetwater.com/shop/guitars/electric-guitars/): Solidbody, semi-hollow, hollowbody, baritone, and extended-range electric guitars.
- [Acoustic Guitars](https://www.sweetwater.com/shop/guitars/acoustic/): Steel-string, 12-string, acoustic-electric, and classical guitars.
- [Guitar Pedals](https://www.sweetwater.com/shop/guitars/guitar-pedals/): Overdrive, distortion, fuzz, delay, reverb, modulation, and multi-effects.
- [Audio Interfaces](https://www.sweetwater.com/shop/studio-recording/audio-interfaces/): USB, Thunderbolt, and Ethernet interfaces from brands including Universal Audio, Focusrite, RME, MOTU, Audient, Apogee, and Solid State Logic.
- [Studio Monitors](https://www.sweetwater.com/shop/studio-recording/studio-monitors/): Studio monitors for home and professional studios.
- [PA Systems & Speakers](https://www.sweetwater.com/shop/live-sound/pa-systems-speakers/): Powered PA speakers, subwoofers, complete PA systems, and stage monitors.
- [Live Sound Mixers](https://www.sweetwater.com/shop/live-sound/mixers/): Analog, digital, and powered mixers for bands, venues, and houses of worship.
- [Electronic Drums](https://www.sweetwater.com/shop/drums-percussion/electronic-drums/): Electronic drum kits, modules, pads, and drum machines.
- [Eurorack & Modular Synthesizers](https://www.sweetwater.com/shop/keyboards-synthesizers/eurorack-modular-synthesizers/): Eurorack modules, cases, and modular systems.
- [Podcasting Equipment](https://www.sweetwater.com/shop/content-creator/podcasting-equipment/): Gear for recording and producing podcasts.

## Shopping tools and services

- [Guitar Gallery](https://www.sweetwater.com/guitar-gallery/): High-resolution photos of the actual instrument you will receive, so shoppers can compare wood grain, weight, and serial number between individual guitars of the same model.
- [Cable Finder](https://www.sweetwater.com/shop/cables/finder.php): Find the right cable for a specific piece of gear.
- [Case Finder](https://www.sweetwater.com/shop/cases/finder/): Find a case or gig bag that fits a specific instrument or piece of gear.
- [Mesa/Boogie Amp Customizer](https://www.sweetwater.com/custom/mesa-boogie/): Configure a custom Mesa/Boogie amplifier.
- [64 Audio Customizer](https://www.sweetwater.com/customizer/64audio): Design custom 64 Audio in-ear monitors.
- [Guitar Workshop](https://www.sweetwater.com/shop/guitars/guitar-repair-shop/): Sweetwater's in-house guitar techs and luthiers; customers can request a custom setup before a new guitar ships.
- [PLEK](https://www.sweetwater.com/shop/guitars/plek/index.php): Computer-guided PLEK fretwork available through the Guitar Workshop.
- [Electronic Repairs Workshop](https://www.sweetwater.com/shop/electronic-repair-shop/): Sweetwater's factory-certified repair service for electronic gear.
- [Instrument Rentals](https://www.sweetwater.com/instrument-rentals/): Nationwide band and orchestra instrument rentals with flexible terms and free repairs.
- [Studio & Commercial Installs](https://www.sweetwater.com/install/): Design and installation for recording studios and commercial spaces.
- [House of Worship](https://www.sweetwater.com/worship/): Gear and resources for churches and houses of worship.
- [Immersive Audio](https://www.sweetwater.com/immersive/): Gear for Dolby Atmos and immersive production.
- [Content Creators hub](https://www.sweetwater.com/shop/content-creators/): Sweetwater's page for podcasters, streamers, and YouTube creators, with creator stories, how-to articles, and guides. It has no product grid; for products, use Content Creator Gear under Shop by department.
- [Institutional, Education & Nonprofit Sales](https://www.sweetwater.com/help/ordering-information.php#nonprofit): Purchasing for schools, churches, nonprofits, and other organizations.

## Deals, open-box, and used gear

- [DealZone](https://www.sweetwater.com/dealzone): Current sales, price drops, bundles, rebates, open-box, B-stock, and used items sold by Sweetwater.
- [Price Drops](https://www.sweetwater.com/dealzone/price-drops): Items with recently reduced prices.
- [Certified Open Box](https://www.sweetwater.com/dealzone/demos): Open-box and demo gear at a discount.
- [B-Stock](https://www.sweetwater.com/dealzone/bstock): Discounted B-stock items (see the condition definitions below).
- [Used, sold by Sweetwater](https://www.sweetwater.com/dealzone/used): Pre-owned gear sold by Sweetwater itself, covered by a 90-day used gear guarantee.
- [Product condition definitions](https://www.sweetwater.com/help/product-information.php): What New, Certified Open Box, B-Stock, and Used mean at Sweetwater.

## Gear Exchange

- [Gear Exchange](https://www.sweetwater.com/used): Sweetwater's peer-to-peer marketplace where musicians buy and sell used gear with each other.
- [How Gear Exchange works](https://www.sweetwater.com/used/how-it-works): Listing, selling, shipping, and payout details.
- [Gear Exchange Help Center](https://www.sweetwater.com/used/help): All help articles for Gear Exchange buyers and sellers.
- [How am I protected?](https://www.sweetwater.com/used/help/buying/how-am-I-protected): Buyer protection. Every seller must state a return policy and is responsible for items that arrive damaged or not as described.
- [Problems with a purchase](https://www.sweetwater.com/used/help/buying/what-if-i-have-a-problem-with-the-item-i-purchased): How to report a problem from the order page. Sellers have 48 hours to respond, seller return windows run from 7 to 30 days, and items sold "as is" can still be returned or refunded if reported damaged, defective, or not as described within 7 days of delivery.
- [Return shipping costs](https://www.sweetwater.com/used/help/buying/who-pays-return-shipping-costs): Buyers pay return shipping on returns without cause; sellers pay when an item arrives damaged, defective, or not as described.
- [Avoiding fraud and scams](https://www.sweetwater.com/used/help/buying/avoiding-fraud-and-scams): Warning signs of scams. Gear Exchange protections apply only to purchases completed on Gear Exchange.
- [Payment methods](https://www.sweetwater.com/used/help/buying/what-payment-methods-can-i-use): Visa, Mastercard, American Express, Discover, JCB, Diners Club, PayPal, Apple Pay, and Venmo. Sweetwater gift cards, the Sweetwater Card, Bonus Bucks, and store credit cannot be used on Gear Exchange.
- [Making an offer](https://www.sweetwater.com/used/help/buying/how-do-i-make-an-offer): How to make an offer on a listing that accepts offers.
- [Where Gear Exchange sells](https://www.sweetwater.com/used/help/buying/can-i-buy-or-sell-items-internationally): Sales are limited to the 50 US states, Washington DC, US territories, and APO/FPO addresses; shipping to freight forwarders is not allowed.
- [Sales tax](https://www.sweetwater.com/used/help/buying/does-gear-exchange-collect-state-sales-tax): The states where Gear Exchange collects sales tax.
- [Listing gear for sale](https://www.sweetwater.com/used/help/selling/how-do-i-list-an-item-on-gear-exchange): Step-by-step instructions and a video for creating a listing.
- [Grading used gear](https://www.sweetwater.com/used/help/selling/how-to-grade-the-condiiton-of-your-used-gear): Gear Exchange's condition scale: Mint, Excellent, Good, Fair, and Poor.
- [Seller fees](https://www.sweetwater.com/used/help/selling/what-are-the-gear-exchange-fees-for-a-seller): Both fees are waived when the seller takes the payout as a Sweetwater gift card. Otherwise Gear Exchange withholds a 5% seller fee (on the sale price and shipping charged) and a 2.5% transaction fee (on the full order amount, including tax).
- [Seller payouts](https://www.sweetwater.com/used/help/selling/what-happens-after-i-make-a-sale-when-do-i-get-paid): Payout timeline after a sale, by Hyperwallet or Sweetwater gift card. Sellers have 3 days to ship.
- [Seller returns](https://www.sweetwater.com/used/help/selling/do-i-need-to-accept-a-return): When sellers must accept a return and who covers the costs.

## Buying guides

## Policies

- [Free shipping](https://www.sweetwater.com/about/free-shipping/): Free shipping with no minimum purchase on nearly everything in stock, to the contiguous US. Free shipping does not apply to special orders, oversized or overweight items, or orders placed on a purchase order, and orders to Alaska, Hawaii, or international addresses may not qualify. APO/FPO addresses ship free via USPS.
- [Shipping and delivery](https://www.sweetwater.com/help/shipping-delivery.php): Most orders ship the same day from Fort Wayne, Indiana or Glendale, Arizona; ground delivery typically takes 1-5 business days. Because of manufacturer restrictions, Sweetwater can ship only some items outside the US; Puerto Rico, APO/FPO addresses, and territories that use US ZIP codes (such as Guam and the US Virgin Islands) are exceptions. Customers outside the US should call (800) 222-4700 to confirm an item can ship.
- [Returns and exchanges](https://www.sweetwater.com/help/returns-exchanges.php): Under Sweetwater's "No Hassle" return policy, new products can be returned for a refund, in-house credit, or exchange, usually within 30 days of the ship date. Customers call their Sales Engineer for a Return Authorization (RA) number and return the item in the condition received, with all accessories and original packaging. If the order shipped free, the outbound shipping cost is deducted from the refund. Items with a redeemed manufacturer rebate incur a restocking fee, and returned woodwind and brass instruments carry a sanitization fee. Not returnable: special orders, customer-requested modifications (such as setups or PLEK work), software and authorization keys, oversized or overweight items, discontinued and closeout items, used items (except under the 90-day Used Gear Guarantee: a used item bought from Sweetwater that malfunctions or fails within 90 days of purchase, and has not been abused or misused, can be returned for a refund or in-house credit, with the customer paying shipping both ways), tubes, replacement speakers, personal items (earphones, harmonicas, recorders), turntable cartridges and styli, control vinyl, open-box reeds, and opened or used ship kits.
- [Warranty: Total Confidence Coverage](https://www.sweetwater.com/about/warranty/): Sweetwater's free 2-year warranty on nearly every new product, covering parts and labor, with repairs by Sweetwater's factory-certified Service Department. It runs alongside the manufacturer's warranty and does not shorten it. Not covered: consumables (strings, tubes, batteries, drum heads), cymbals, software, Apple products, and used items. The warranty is not transferable, and the customer pays shipping to and from Sweetwater. If an item fails under warranty within 30 days of purchase, Sweetwater covers US shipping to replace it. Used items are covered instead by the 90-day Used Gear Guarantee (see Returns and exchanges).
- [Price protection](https://www.sweetwater.com/about/price-protection/): If Sweetwater's own price drops within 60 days of purchase, the customer's Sales Engineer refunds the difference while the lower price is still available.
- [Payment options](https://www.sweetwater.com/about/payments/): Visa, Mastercard, American Express, Discover, Diners Club, JCB, PayPal and PayPal Credit, Apple Pay, Affirm, Sweetwater Easy Payments (interest-free installments on an existing card with no hard credit check), the Sweetwater Card (promotional financing of up to 48 months on qualifying purchases; offers and terms vary by brand), gift cards, and financing for businesses and nonprofits.
- [Sales tax](https://www.sweetwater.com/help/ordering-information.php#sales-tax): How sales tax applies to Sweetwater orders.
